LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_AllowSno: When enabled, right-clicking an offered project snoozes it so it is not offered again until you unsnooze it from the history button. When disabled, snoozing is unavailable and any already snoozed projects go back into the pool. Your snoozed list is kept, so turning this back on restores it.
